retrievalProfile.description: A high-key group portrait set against a stark white void that transitions into a starry, airbrushed cosmic sky at the top edge.

recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-person group portrait where subjects are isolated on a pure white background that bleeds into a dark, starry nebula at the top. The composition features a mix of chrome-styled script and bold sans-serif typography positioned in the upper third.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast transition from pure white floor to dark cosmic sky
Chrome script typography overlapping the sky/void boundary
Subjects arranged in a loose, layered horizontal line
Vibrant 80s fashion colors popping against the neutral white background
coreInvariants: The horizon line must be a soft gradient transition from white to dark purple/blue stars.
Subjects must appear to stand in a non-dimensional white space.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body group centered horizontally, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central female figure in a purple metallic dress acts as the focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the large chrome script in the top left, across the subtitle to the right, then down to the group of figures.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white negative space surrounding the subjects' legs and mid-sections.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value background with high-saturation clothing accents and deep-value sky.
paletteRestrictions: No earthy or muted tones in the background
Strict separation between the white floor and the dark sky

letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses a heavy, slanted script with chrome-like airbrushed gradients.
Secondary title uses a wide, all-caps geometric sans-serif.
Horizontal lines or 'speed streaks' extend from the script letters.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'M' and 'S' in the script are oversized with flourishing tails.
The sans-serif 'A' lacks a crossbar or has a very low one.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a fluid, metallic script with a rigid, spaced-out geometric sans.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 80s fluid motion of the main title.
Matches the wide, geometric feel of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a group portrait of 8-9 people in 1980s futuristic fashion, standing on a pure white floor that fades upward into a dark purple starry nebula at the very top edge.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large chrome-textured script logo in the top left and a wide-tracked magenta sans-serif title in the top right.

verificationChecks: Is the background pure white behind the subjects' legs?
Does the sky transition smoothly from the white void?
Is the script title metallic in appearance?
Is the subtitle text widely spaced?

adjustableVariables: Number of people in the group
mustRedesign: Do not replicate exact facial features of the original artists
Ensure the 'Solar' logo equivalent is replaced with generic graphic elements

mustAchieve: Seamless gradient from white to space

postGenerationChecks: Check for chrome gradient consistency in script
Ensure no feet are cut off by the frame
Confirm wide tracking on the secondary title
recipe.reuseFormula: High-key studio photography + cosmic header gradient + chrome script + wide geometric sans-serif.
